swimsuit noun

also swimming costume, bathing suit, swimwear

late Latin

Traupman 389
Lampr. Alex. Sev. 42 (Lewis & Short)

vestis balneāris

swimsuit; bathing clothes

Other words

  • vestis natātōria — swimsuit

    also used · modern · M-O 38 s.v. swimsuit

  • subligāculum balneāre — swimsuit

    also used · modern · Vatican lexicon

    Traupman and Morgan–Owens use this phrase and its variant for swimming trunks.

See also swimming trunks.
